usage: The word '影片' refers to any recorded video content, such as films, clips, or home videos.
'影片' can be used as the object of a sentence, for example, '我睇咗個影片' means 'I watched a video.'
It can be combined with verbs related to media like 播放 (to play), 上載 (to upload), or 剪輯 (to edit).
'影片' is often used in digital contexts, but it can refer to traditional films as well.
In questions, you can ask '你有冇睇過呢個影片？' to mean 'Have you watched this video?'
